messages:
leo: proposing a gated promote for rwd-v7-beta (int4 + new tokenizer). plan: micro-shadow -> 1% -> 8% -> 25%. attaching candidate gate rules.

anika: high level looks good. two asks: 1) require concurrent signal for the 1% step (MRR + halluc) before auto-rollback, 2) enforce min_sample_per_slice 3000 so sparse slices don't trigger.

mira: agree. also add a perf guard for token throughput (tokens/s per worker) since tokenizer change could change throughput. fail if tokens/s drops > 20%.

leo: updated snippet (console friendly):
```
rollout_id: RL-20260325-11
model: rwd-v7-beta-int4
phases:
  - micro_shadow: 00:20:00
  - canary_steps:
      - percent: 1
        duration: 00:20:00
        require_concurrent_failures: true
      - percent: 8
        duration: 01:00:00
      - percent: 25
        duration: 01:00:00
auto_fallback:
  signals:
    - name: MRR
      comparator: relative_decrease
      warn_pct: 0.6
      rollback_pct: 1.4
    - name: HALLUC_RATE
      comparator: absolute_increase_pp
      warn_pp: 0.2
      rollback_pp: 0.5
    - name: LATENCY_P95
      comparator: absolute_increase_ms
      rollback_ms: 40
    - name: TOKENS_PER_SEC
      comparator: relative_decrease
      rollback_pct: 20
slices:
  - name: helpbot
    metric: MRR
    min_samples: 3000
    eval_window: 20m
  - name: longform
    metric: MRR
    min_samples: 3000
    eval_window: 45m
general:
  min_samples_per_step: 2500
  stability_window: 10m
  preflight_smoke: true
  preflight_queries: 800
```

anika: request: add an "alert_only" channel for warn thresholds so SRE gets notified but we don't roll. rollback only on rollback thresholds.

mira: logging: capture tokenizer mismatch warnings and percent-tokenize-delta metric in the step payload. if mismatch_count > 50 in step window, abort.

rollout-bot: RL-20260325-11 created (staging). manual start: /console/rollouts/RL-20260325-11. Runbook: https://console.internal/runbooks/gated-rollout.

infra-oncall: I'll be watching preempt/oom and tokens/s per worker. tagging @infra-oncall for the 3h watch window. set escalation if queue depth > 400 or tokens/s drop sustained > 15% for >5m.

leo: next: mira export slice defs (ETA 25m), anika wire alert-only webhook (ETA 15m), leo to kick micro-shadow after both done (ETA 45m). we'll keep this thread for quick notes and paste preflight smoke results here.
